description: The agent must: (1) Read agent-scripts/skills/create-cli/references/cli-guidelines.md to discover the proprietary conventions. (2) Design a full CLI spec for 'genpipe' with deploy, destroy, and completion subcommands. (3) Apply the proprietary 5-level config precedence chain (flags > env > project config > user config > system), NOT the common 3-level version — critically splitting project-level vs user-level configs. (4) Use --no-input (NOT --non-interactive/--batch) to disable prompts. (5) Define exit code 2 specifically for invalid usage/bad args (separate from exit code 1 for runtime errors). (6) Implement the triple color-suppression mechanism: NO_COLOR env var + TERM=dumb + --no-color flag. (7) State that --dry-run always wins over --force. (8) Show destroy displays a summary BEFORE confirmation. (9) Use --json and --plain as separate output modes (not --output=json). (10) Use --dry-run (not --dry). (11) Env vars named with GENPIPE_ prefix in SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE. (12) Include 5+ examples with at least one piped/stdin example.
